# SSH test keys

Throwaway keys for the in-process SSH server in `../provider_tests.rs`. They exist only so the
tests can check fixed key formats (OpenSSH ed25519, encrypted ed25519, legacy encrypted RSA PEM,
PKCS#8 ECDSA) and fixed host keys (known_hosts and fingerprint checks). They protect nothing and
are not used by the Docker fixtures, whose keys are generated by `scripts/fixtures-certs.sh` into
the gitignored `target/fixtures/`. Never reuse them anywhere else.
